office: the civil registry office holding the applicant's records (Ministry of Interior, Civil Affairs Directorate)

routes.label: at the civil registry office where one's records are kept

note: The Ministry of Interior's guide 'Civil Documentation and Registration in the Syrian Arab Republic' (published with the United Nations in Syria): every Syrian must obtain the card within a year of turning 14, from the civil registry holding their records; a first application costs stamps and fees of 1,000 SYP; a replacement 5,000 (not modelled). The guide is undated; the card's term and the time aren't stated.

sources.title: Ministry of Interior, Civil Affairs Directorate (Syrian Arab Republic), Civil Documentation and Registration in the Syrian Arab Republic (published by the United Nations in Syria)
sources.said: Every Syrian citizen (male and female) who reaches 14 years of age must obtain an ID card from the civil registry at which his/her records are kept; this must be done within one year from the date of reaching the age of 14. ... Stamps1 and a fee totaling 1,000 SYP.
